## Reading the audit

Each runtime is split into the four core mutation mechanisms and the separate, fail-soft diagnostic hook. RVA, byte length, internal classification, complete stock bytes/disassembly, and replacement bytes/disassembly are recorded for every site. Release aliases and explicit false-positive exclusions appear in a non-patch appendix.

A static document cannot contain launch-specific displacement bytes. Table references target a dynamically allocated 64 MiB table, and diagnostic calls target an allocated relay page. The table's RIP-relative `disp32` fields and the calls' `rel32` fields are shown as `?? ?? ?? ??`, together with the exact formula used to produce them. Every other replacement byte is exact.

## Classification legend

| Classification | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <code>index_mask</code> | Widen the table-entry/raw-handle index mask from 20 to 22 bits. |
| <code>age_mask</code> | Move the unchanged six-bit generation field from bits 20–25 to 22–27. |
| <code>age_inc_or_count</code> | Move the generation increment or entry-count constant by two bits. |
| <code>table_bytes</code> | Increase the table byte extent from 16 MiB to 64 MiB. |
| <code>clear_age</code> | Clear the relocated generation field while retaining the widened index. |
| <code>clear_next</code> | Clear the widened next-index field. |
| <code>clear_inuse</code> | Clear the relocated in-use bit. |
| <code>inuse_bit</code> | Move an immediate in-use mask from bit 26 to bit 28. |
| <code>inuse_bitpos</code> | Move a BT/BTS/BTR bit position from 26 to 28. |
| <code>sidecar_read</code> | Read the complete 22-bit object index from the adjacent padding dword. |
| <code>sidecar_write</code> | Publish the full sidecar index while preserving the legacy object word. |
| <code>sidecar_release</code> | Clear the legacy object word and sidecar together. |
| <code>table_relocation</code> | Retarget one RIP-relative table-address displacement. |
| <code>init_guard</code> | Conditionally prevent stock initialization from overwriting the raised pool. |
| <code>diagnostic_hook</code> | Optionally redirect a successful assignment CALL through the reuse relay. |

## Regeneration

Run from the `Skyrim/` project directory after regenerating or reviewing the JSON profiles:

```powershell
python probes\gen_patch_docs.py --se artifacts\patch_SE.json --ae artifacts\patch_AE.json --gog artifacts\patch_GOG.json --vr artifacts\patch_VR.json --out-dir docs\patch-sites
python probes\verify_deliverable.py --offline
```

The verifier renders these files again in memory, requires byte-for-byte equality, and independently derives every documented mutation/evidence record ID from the exact JSON schema, requiring each one exactly once.
